item.description: The base NotifyBase class has a bug in the _build_send_calls method where it raises a TypeError when a notification fails to send due to missing body or attachment, but it should return False instead to indicate failure.

contract.behavior: The _build_send_calls method should catch TypeError exceptions raised during notification preparation and return False to indicate that the notification failed to send, rather than propagating the exception.
contract.inputs: Method receives body, title, notify_type, overflow, attach, body_format parameters
contract.outputs: Should return False when notification preparation fails, True when successful
contract.exceptions: No TypeError should be propagated from _build_send_calls

item.description: The Nextcloud plugin has issues with notification type handling in certain error scenarios where it doesn't properly handle NotifyType.INFO values during group expansion and error fallbacks.

contract.behavior: The send method should properly handle notification type when performing group expansion and error fallbacks, ensuring that notification type is correctly maintained throughout the process.
contract.inputs: Method receives body, title, notify_type parameters
contract.outputs: Should return False when all targets fail to send, True when at least one succeeds
contract.exceptions: Should not raise TypeError when notification type is NotifyType.INFO

item.description: The Resend plugin incorrectly handles URL parsing for malformed URLs, particularly when targets are empty or invalid, causing incorrect behavior in URL validation.

contract.behavior: The parse_url method should correctly parse and validate Resend URLs, returning None for malformed URLs instead of raising exceptions or returning incomplete results.
contract.outputs: Dictionary with parsed parameters or None if invalid
contract.exceptions: Should not raise exceptions for invalid URLs

item.description: The SendGrid plugin fails to properly validate target email addresses in certain edge cases, particularly when handling invalid email addresses that should be dropped but aren't.

contract.behavior: The __init__ method should properly validate and filter target email addresses, dropping invalid ones and ensuring at least one valid target exists for notification.
contract.inputs: API key, from_email, targets, cc, bcc parameters
contract.outputs: Instance with validated targets list, or TypeError for invalid from_email
contract.exceptions: Should not allow invalid email addresses to remain in targets list

item.description: The Slack plugin has issues with URL parsing for native Slack URLs, particularly when parsing webhook URLs that don't match the expected pattern.

contract.behavior: The parse_url method should correctly parse native Slack webhook URLs (like https://hooks.slack.com/services/...) and return appropriate parameters.
contract.outputs: Dictionary with parsed parameters including token_a, token_b, token_c, or None for invalid URLs
contract.exceptions: Should not fail when parsing standard Slack webhook URLs
